tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: Return public Altair page paths, URLs, titles and descriptions. Use this to discover pages before read_page.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Return a public Altair page's full markdown with its path, URL, title and description. Use a path from list_pages when you need the page content.

tools.name: get_market_breadth
tools.description: Return the latest S&P 500 sector breadth and S&P 500, Nasdaq-100 and PHLX Semiconductor (SOX) constituent percentages above their 20-session simple moving averages, with SPX, NDX and SOX price-index benchmark levels (no dividends). History uses the loader's constituent lists, not point-in-time membe

tools.name: get_market_indicators
tools.description: Return the latest readings of ten factor indicators and TD Sequential 9 (daily and weekly) for the S&P 500 (SPX), Nasdaq-100 (NDX) and PHLX Semiconductor (SOX) price indices: value, reading, bullish/neutral/bearish signal, the rule's bands and the previous session's value and signal, with each rule'

tools.name: get_ticker_indicators
tools.description: Return latest factor and daily/weekly TD Sequential readings for one Yahoo Finance symbol, with session, price, rules, sources and historical index evidence. Reuses /api/market/indicators?ticker=; no chart histories. Stock implied volatility and variance risk premium are null; VIX term structure, cr

tools.name: list_research_reports
tools.description: Return published TradingAgents report metadata and URLs newest first, the matching total and counts for all tickers. Use this to find reports before read_research_report, optionally filter by ticker and page with limit and offset.

tools.name: get_research_decisions
tools.description: Return every model's final portfolio decision for one ticker on its newest analysis date, or a chosen one: rating, report-time price, price target, confidence, time horizon and executive summary, with report URLs. Set includePrevious to compare each represented model's rating with its nearest earlie

tools.name: read_research_report
tools.description: Return a full TradingAgents report as markdown, its ticker, date, model and URL, and an informational-only disclaimer; sections cover analyst reports, research decisions, trading plans, risk management and portfolio decisions. Use a url from list_research_reports for free access without sign-in.

tools.name: get_research_signals
tools.description: Return the latest final portfolio decision per ticker as structured JSON, including report dates, models, source URLs and summaries. Optional tickers and since filters; ten-minute cache. Costs $0.01 USD per call by default via x402 payments inside MCP; the payment challenge gives the current price.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "get_market_indicators" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
